description:
Agentic Browser Automation Tool

A JSON-over-HTTP server that owns a real Chrome or Edge window, so an AI agent
drives a browser by posting small commands instead of writing WebDriver code.
The browser stays up between calls, so tabs, logins and focus persist across a
session.

It drives an existing Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge and bundles neither. Run
`abt doctor` after installing to check what is present and where the browser
profile will live. The command is `abt`.

Starting the server at every logon is opt-in, user-level and never installed by
default: `abt autostart install --browser chrome`.
